questions.markdown:
By changing the order of integration evaluate

$$
\int_0^a \int_0^{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}} \sqrt{a^2-x^2-y^2}\,dy\,dx
$$
Find the volume bounded by portion of the sphere $x^2+y^2+z^2=a^2$ lying inside the cylinder $x^2+y^2=ax$

By using the transformation $x+y=u$, $y=uv$ evaluate

$$
\int_0^1 \int_0^{1-x} e^{\frac{y}{x+y}}\,dy\,dx
$$

questions.markdown: Find the directional derivative of the function $xy^2+yz^2+zx^2$ along the tangent to the curve $x=t$, $y=t^2$, $z=t^3$ at the point $(1,1,1)$
Verify Green's theorem for $\oint_C 2xy\,dx-y^2\,dy$ where $C$ is ellipse $3x^2+4y^2=12$

Find the rank of the matrix $A=$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 1 & -3 & -1\\
1 & 0 & 1 & 1\\
3 & 1 & 0 & 2\\
1 & 1 & -2 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$

Test for consistency and solve by Gauss elimination method

$$
\begin{aligned}
3x+3y+2z&=1\\
x+2y&=4\\
10y+3z&=-2\\
2x-3y-z&=5
\end{aligned}
$$

Using Gauss Jordan method, find the inverse of the following matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}
8 & 4 & 3\\
2 & 1 & 1\\
1 & 2 & 1
\end{bmatrix}
$$
Show that if a set of vectors are linearly independent then every subset is also linearly independent.
Test whether the following set of vectors $\{(1,2,3),(1,1,1),(1,0,1)\}$ forms a basis for $\mathbb{E}^3$. If so express $(3,1,2)$ as linear combination of basis vectors.
Using Gram-Schmidt process construct an orthonormal basis from the set of vectors $\{a_1=(1,1,1), a_2=(2,-1,2), a_3=(1,2,3)\}$ in $\mathbb{E}^3$.

questions.markdown: A rectangular box open at the top is said to have volume of 32 cubic feet. Find the dimensions of the box requiring the least material for its construction.

If

$$
u=\cosec^{-1}\!\left(\frac{(x^{1/2}+y^{1/2})^{1/2}}{(x^{1/3}+y^{1/3})^{1/3}}\right).
$$

Then prove that

$$
x^2\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+2xy\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}+y^2\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=\frac{\tan u}{12}\left(\frac{13}{12}+\frac{\tan^2u}{12}\right).
$$
